headline: Affle 3i meets GIC Singapore on Nov 24
summary: Affle 3i Limited held an in-person one-on-one meeting with GIC, Singapore on November 24, 2026. The company confirmed no unpublished price sensitive information was shared during the interaction.

headline: Kapil Raj Finance CFO resigns effective Nov 24
summary: Santosh Rani resigned as CFO of Kapil Raj Finance citing personal reasons. The resignation is effective November 24, 2026, per SEBI compliance filings.

headline: Shadowfax acquires WeFast assets for $2.5M
summary: Shadowfax Technologies acquires IP and business assets from Incrin and Wefast for $2.5 million to expand intra-city logistics reach.

headline: Arisinfra shareholders approve RPT limits
summary: Arisinfra Solutions members passed postal ballot resolutions approving material related party transactions with JS Infra Core and Buildmex-Infra, setting specific financial caps.

headline: Orkla India board approves new director appointments
summary: Orkla India Ltd's board approved the appointment of Audun Stensvold as Additional Director and extended terms for three Independent Directors. The changes await shareholder approval via postal ballot.

headline: Clean Max seeks shareholder nod for ₹19,129 crore RPTs
summary: Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Limited has issued a postal ballot notice seeking approval for material related party transactions with 61 subsidiaries and associates. The aggregate value of proposed transactions exceeds the materiality threshold of ₹191.29 crore.

headline: GK Energy reports insider trading violation by promoter
summary: GK Energy Limited reported a violation of the Code of Conduct under SEBI (PIT) Regulations, 2015 by Designated Person Ashok P. Rathi. The company issued a warning letter citing inadvertent lapses.

headline: Choice International to host analyst meet Nov 27
summary: Choice International Ltd will participate in an analyst and institutional investor meeting with Nimida Capital and Tungaa Investments on November 27, 2026, in Bengaluru.

headline: Himadri Speciality to meet investors in Asia
summary: Himadri Speciality Chemical Ltd will host analyst and institutional investor meetings in Singapore and Hong Kong on November 30 and December 1, 2026.

headline: Aster DM Quality Care appoints new IR VP
summary: Aster DM Quality Care Limited appointed Saurabh Anand Bhandari as Vice President - Investor Relations effective November 23, 2026. He succeeds Sunil Kumar M R in the interim role.

headline: Steamhouse H1FY27 EBITDA jumps 66% on margin expansion
summary: Steamhouse India Ltd reported a 65.72% YoY rise in EBITDA to ₹556.15 million in H1FY27, driven by improved capacity utilization and operating leverage.

headline: Archean Chemical appoints Rajesh Nair as CEO of SiCSem
summary: Archean Chemical Industries appointed Rajesh Nair as CEO of SiCSem Private Limited, effective November 9, 2026. Nair will lead the silicon carbide fab project in Odisha.

headline: Apeejay Surrendra Park Hotels Q2FY27 Results
summary: Apeejay Surrendra Park Hotels reported 7% YoY revenue growth to ₹180 crore in Q2FY27. Operating EBITDA rose 11% to ₹54 crore, though PAT dipped due to higher depreciation and interest costs from recent acquisitions.
